Privacy Policy 
Introduction 
Welcome to scoopi ("we," "our," or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to 
protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and 
safeguard your information when you visit our website, use our mobile application, or interact 
with our e-commerce platform (collectively, the "Services"). 
This policy applies to all users of our Services, including buyers, sellers, and casual visitors. 
Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy 
Policy, please do not access the Services. 
1. Information We Collect 
We collect information that identifies, relates to, describes, or could reasonably be linked, 
directly or indirectly, with you ("Personal Information"). We may collect this information in the 
following ways: 
A. Information You Provide Us 
• Account Registration: When you create an account as a buyer or a seller, we collect

A. Information You Provide Us 
• Account Registration: When you create an account as a buyer or a seller, we collect 
your name, email address, username, password, and phone number. 
• Profile Information: Sellers may provide additional business information, such as store 
name, business address, tax identification numbers, and banking details for payouts. 
Buyers may save shipping and billing addresses. 
• Transaction Information: When you buy or sell a product, we collect details about the 
transaction, including the items purchased, purchase price, date, and shipping details. 
• Payment Information: We use third-party payment processors (e.g., [Stripe, PayPal, 
etc.]). We do not store full credit card numbers on our servers. We only retain payment 
tokens and partial billing information necessary for order confirmation and fraud 
prevention.

• Communications: Information you provide when you contact our customer support,

B. Information Collected Automatically 
• Device Data: IP address, browser type, operating system, device identifiers, and mobile 
network information. 
• Usage Data: Pages viewed, time spent on pages, links clicked, search queries, and 
interaction with platform features.

• Cookies and Tracking Technologies: We use cookies, web beacons, and similar 
technologies to track activity on our platform and hold certain information (see our 
[Cookie Policy link, if applicable] for more details). 
C. Information from Third Parties 
We may receive information about you from third parties, such as payment processors, identity 
verification services (especially for sellers), and social media platforms if you choose to link 
your accounts. 
2. How We Use Your Information 
We use the information we collect for various business and commercial purposes, including to: 
• Provide and Maintain the Services: Facilitate account creation, authenticate users, and 
manage platform functionality. 
• Process Transactions: Fulfill orders, process payments, and calculate shipping and 
taxes. 
• Facilitate User Interactions: Enable communication between buyers and sellers 
necessary for order fulfillment and customer service.

• Improve our Services: Analyze usage trends, debug errors, and develop new products,

• Customer Support: Respond to inquiries, resolve disputes, and provide technical

• Marketing and Promotions: Send you promotional emails, newsletters, and offers (you

• Trust and Safety: Prevent fraud, unauthorized access, and illegal activities. Enforce our

• Legal Compliance: Comply with applicable legal obligations, tax reporting 
requirements, and regulatory requests.

3. How We Share Your Information 
We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the 
following situations: 
• Between Buyers and Sellers: To facilitate transactions, we share necessary information 
between the buyer and the seller. For example, a seller will receive a buyer's name, 
shipping address, and order details to fulfill a purchase. Users are strictly prohibited from 
using this information for anything other than completing the transaction.

• Service Providers: We share data with third-party vendors who perform services on our 
behalf, such as payment processing, data analysis, email delivery, hosting services, and 
customer service. 
• Business Transfers: If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, financing due diligence, 
or sale of all or a portion of our assets, your information may be transferred as part of that 
transaction. 
• Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information where required to do so by law 
or subpoena, or if we reasonably believe that such action is necessary to comply with the 
law and the reasonable requests of law enforcement. 
• With Your Consent: We may disclose your personal information for any other purpose 
with your explicit consent. 
4. Your Rights and Choices 
Depending on your location (such as under the GDPR in Europe or CCPA in California), you

4. Your Rights and Choices 
Depending on your location (such as under the GDPR in Europe or CCPA in California), you 
may have certain rights regarding your personal information: 
• Access and Portability: You can request a copy of the personal information we hold 
about you. 
• Correction: You can edit most of your personal information directly within your account 
settings. You can also request that we correct inaccurate data. 
• Deletion: You can request that we delete your personal information or close your 
account, subject to certain legal exceptions (e.g., retaining data for tax/fraud prevention 
purposes). 
• Opt-Out of Marketing: You can unsubscribe from our marketing emails at any time by 
clicking the "unsubscribe" link in the emails or updating your account preferences. 
To exercise any of these rights, please contact us scoopi@gmail.com

5. Data Retention 
We will retain your personal information only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out 
in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your information to the extent necessary to comply 
with our legal obligations (for example, if we are required to retain your data to comply with 
applicable tax laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies. 
6. Security of Your Information 
We use administrative, technical, and physical security measures to help protect your personal 
information (such as SSL encryption for data transmission). While we have taken reasonable 
steps to secure the personal information you provide to us, please be aware that despite our

efforts, no security measures are perfect or impenetrable, and no method of data transmission can 
be guaranteed against any interception or other type of misuse. 
7. Children's Privacy 
Our Services are not intended for use by children under the age of 18 [or applicable age of 
majority in your jurisdiction]. We do not knowingly collect personal identifiable information 
from children. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child without 
verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove that information from our servers. 
8. Changes to This Privacy Policy 
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our practices or for 
other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any material changes by 
posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date. We may also 
notify you via email or through a prominent notice on our platform.

• Account Security: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your

• Account Liability: You are entirely responsible for all activities that occur under your

4. Selling on the Platform (Seller Terms) 
If you register as a Seller, you agree to the following: 
• Listing Accuracy: You must accurately describe your items and terms of sale. 
• Prohibited Items: You may not list items that are illegal, counterfeit, hazardous, or 
violate our [Prohibited Items Policy link, if applicable]. 
• Fulfillment: You are solely responsible for processing, fulfilling, and shipping orders in a 
timely manner as outlined in the Delivery Policy section.

• Fees: You agree to pay the applicable platform fees and commissions as outlined in our 
[Seller Fee Schedule link]. 
5. Buying on the Platform (Buyer Terms) 
If you use the Platform to purchase items, you agree to the following: 
• Purchasing: By placing an order, you agree to pay the listed price, along with shipping 
fees and applicable taxes. 
• Payment Authorization: You authorize us (and our third-party payment processors) to 
charge your selected payment method for the total order amount. 
6. Delivery and Shipping Policy 
• Seller Responsibility: Sellers are responsible for packaging and shipping the products to 
the buyer within [Insert Number, e.g., 3 to 5] business days of receiving the order, unless 
otherwise stated in the product listing. 
• Shipping Methods and Costs: Shipping costs and available delivery methods are 
determined by the seller and displayed at checkout. 
• Tracking: Sellers are highly encouraged (or required) to provide valid tracking

determined by the seller and displayed at checkout. 
• Tracking: Sellers are highly encouraged (or required) to provide valid tracking 
information for all shipped orders. 
• Risk of Loss: The risk of loss and title for items purchased pass to the buyer upon the 
seller's delivery of the item to the shipping carrier. 
• Delayed Deliveries: While we strive to ensure timely deliveries, we are not liable for 
shipping delays caused by carriers, weather conditions, or incorrect addresses provided 
by the buyer. 
7. Returns and Refunds Policy

• Return Window: Buyers may request a return within [Insert Number, e.g., 14 or 30] 
days of receiving the item. 
• Eligible Items: To be eligible for a return, the item must be unused, in the same 
condition that the buyer received it, and in its original packaging. Certain items (e.g., 
perishables, custom-made products, intimate goods) are exempt from being returned.

• Return Process: Buyers must initiate a return request through their account dashboard. 
The seller must respond to the request within [Insert Number, e.g., 48 hours].

• Return Shipping Costs: Unless the item arrived damaged, defective, or incorrectly 
described, the [Buyer/Seller - Choose one, usually Buyer] is responsible for paying return

• Refunds: Once the seller receives and inspects the returned item, a refund will be issued

• Platform Mediation: If a dispute arises between a buyer and a seller regarding a return 
or refund, scoopi reserves the right to step in and mediate the dispute. Our decision in 
such mediations will be final.
